readout_other: Functional ultrasound CBV imaging; EMG (CMAP); DeepLabCut hindpaw tracking; displacement imaging; open field test; doublecortin immunofluorescence; H&E staining
direction_notes: A single 80 ms pulse at 1.69 to 3.39 MPa in ketamine/xylazine anaesthetised mice evoked dose-dependent ipsilateral CBV increases and hindlimb, toe and tail motor responses, with no response at 0 MPa or 0.5 mm off target. Bilateral hippocampal sonication was followed three weeks later by more time in the open-field centre than sham.
safety_notes: H&E staining after 3.39 MPa sonication (n = 1 animal) showed no brain damage; a 1.72 C temperature rise was measured for a 10-pulse train.

exposures.label: 4 MHz DgFUS of thalamus and somatosensory cortex (cranial window, motor responses)

timing.protocol_description: Continuous FUS pulses with a pulse duration of 80 ms (320k cycles, 4 MHz) and a sonication duration of 10 s at a pulse repetition frequency of 1 Hz; pressure 0 (sham) to 3.39 MPa, all stated as derated. FUS was manually scanned over the cranial window until motor activation was seen.

exposures.label: Transcranial fUS-guided FUS of bilateral hippocampus (FUS-N)

timing.protocol_description: FUS was applied for 2 minutes (1 Hz PRF, 1.9 MPa pressure, and 150 ms pulse duration) with a total of 120 FUS pulses delivered per bilateral target. Transducer and frequency are not stated for this arm.

flags.reason: Paper states all pressures were derated but not the derating method or whether to tissue; recorded as in_situ derating. Pressure levels 1.69, 2.54, 3.39 MPa read from the latency sentence; 1.54 MPa also named as threshold; intensity only in a figure table.
Paper calls the 80 ms pulse continuous (320k cycles at 4 MHz) repeated at 1 Hz for 10 s; recorded as pulsed. Duty cycle not stated.
Frequency and transducer for the hippocampal FUS-N arm are not stated in the text.
Domain of the 1.9 MPa not stated.
22 is the stated total of mice and includes FUS-BBBO (5) and sham (4) animals and one histology and one temperature animal; the FUS-BBBO arm (microbubbles) is not recorded as an exposure.
No masking; the paper argues non-auditory origin from latency, lateralisation and a 0.5 mm off-target control, classified here as control_experiment.
Sham (0 MPa) in motor experiments and sham mice in the behavioural arm; mechanism not described.
